name: Bestwig (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, blue and white with a broad blue middle stripe, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Bestwig (a white saltire on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Bestwig; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bestwig arms — white saltire on blue
